label: PISA science mean score
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the OECD PISA assessment's own mean science scale scores (the PISA Database, OECD 2023 vintage), 90 entities, the six triennial cycles 2006-2022, reached through OWID's chart door with the science column pinned (the CSV's own header) - the OECD runs the assessment and prints the scale scores itself (the same collector judgment as math_test_scores). No witness tier: the by-sex door is the same root.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: OECD, PISA Database - the OECD's own reuse terms apply upstream).
notes: The science column of the PISA chart, outside Todd's books. Read live on the chart: the six triennial cycles 2006-2022. Sub-national participants ride the door's own entity list and resolve where the registry carries them; an entity that skipped a cycle prints no value for it.

sources.root_label: OECD PISA assessment (the PISA Database mean scale scores; via OWID's chart door)
